title: Infinitude of Sophie Germain Primes
exact_target: Are there infinitely many primes whose double plus one is also prime?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1859 (GUY-A7a). CC BY 4.0.

Matteo Bordignon and Ethan Simpson Lee, \emph{Explicit upper bounds for the number of primes simultaneously representable by any set of irreducible polynomials}, arXiv:2211.11012 (2022), Section 1, the two linear forms $x,2x+1$ and Sophie Germain primes.
